items.evidence: CLARIFICATIONS.md: "Rust with Axum on Tokio"; "SQLite via sqlx with migrations"; design.md D1: "Rust binary with Axum on Tokio; SQLite via sqlx"

CLARIFICATIONS.md: "id (UUID string), title (string), completed (bool), created_at / updated_at (RFC3339 strings)"; spec.md: "id (server-generated UUID string), title (string), completed (boolean), created_at (RFC 3339 UTC), and updated_at"
CLARIFICATIONS.md: "POST /todos, GET /todos, GET /todos/:id, PATCH /todos/:id, DELETE /todos/:id, GET /health"; design.md D3 lists same routes with status codes
design.md D5: "GET /todos?completed=true|false"; spec.md: "Optional query completed=true or completed=false MUST filter results"
design.md D7: "trim title then enforce length 1..=200"; spec.md: "titles longer than 200 characters MUST return 400"; CLARIFICATIONS.md: "reject empty/whitespace-only or length > 200"
CLARIFICATIONS.md: {"error":{"code":"<string>","message":"<string>"}} with codes validation_error, not_found, internal_error"; design.md D4: "Central AppError → { error: { code, message } }"
CLARIFICATIONS.md: "DATABASE_URL (default sqlite:todos.db), HOST (default 127.0.0.1), PORT (default 8080)"; design.md D8 repeats same env vars and defaults

proposal.md: "In-process integration tests for CRUD, validation, filter, and 404 paths"; tasks.md 3.1: "Complete in-process HTTP integration suite: create, list, filter, get, patch, delete"; spec.md Requirement: Integration test coverage
CLARIFICATIONS.md Out of scope: "No auth, ... UI, ... pagination beyond completed filter"; spec.md Requirement: Out of scope: "SHALL NOT require authentication, ... pagination, sorting, UI"
